location.rationale: The location of the resource is critical for compliance and security purposes. This attribute is already covered by an implemented policy in another relevant resource. Therefore, a separate policy was not created for this resource.

active.rationale: This attribute controls the operational state of the rule and has no direct security impact.

display_name.description: Display Name of the auto labeling rule.
display_name.rationale: Used for identification purposes only. No direct security impact.

description.rationale: Used for identification purposes only. No direct security impact.

label_key_type.description: The type of the label key. Possible values are: `LABEL_KEY_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED`, `LABEL_KEY_TYPE_CUSTOM`.
label_key_type.rationale: The type of the label key can have security implications, especially if it's a custom type.

label_key.rationale: The label key itself can have security implications, especially if it contains sensitive information.

conditions.description: Conditions to apply for auto-labeling the label_key. Structure is [documented below](#nested_conditions).
conditions.rationale: Conditions define the logic for when the auto-labeling rule should be applied. While they are critical for the functionality of the rule, they do not have direct security implications.

condition.description: A optional CEL expression to be evaluated as a boolean value. Once evaluated as true, then we will proceed with the value evaluation. An empty condition will be auto evaluated as true.
condition.rationale: Defines CEL evaluation logic for auto-labeling. No direct security impact.

value.description: CEL expression to be evaluated as the value.
value.rationale: Defines the evaluated labeling value only. No direct security impact.

auto_labeling_rule_id.description: A unique ID for the new AutoLabelingRule. This ID will become the final component of the AutoLabelingRule's resource name. If no ID is specified, a server-generated ID will be used. This value should be 4-64 characters and must match the regular expression `^[A-Za-z0-9]{4,64}$`.
auto_labeling_rule_id.rationale: Used for identification purposes only. No direct security impact.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Used for identification purposes only. No direct security impact.
